name: Nagaalaga
imageAlt: Nagaalaga maternal health web portal welcoming mothers and connecting barangay health centers
summary: Civic maternal health platform that reached the Semi-Finals through rigorous quality control and app performance tracking.
description: Developed for the Regional Naga City Hackathon, Nagaalaga is a web and mobile maternal health platform connecting barangay mothers with health centers and obstetricians, backed by structured quality control and performance telemetry.
techStackContext: Led data tracking and performance documentation. Established strict quality control metrics and data records that drove the team to the semi-finals of a competitive hackathon.
